title: Medial and lateral orbitofrontal cortex in approach-avoidance decisions (Starkweather et al., 2026): SEEG high-frequency activity, 6 patients (derivative)
description: Derivative stereo-EEG dataset of high-frequency activity (HFA, 70-150 Hz) recorded from six patients with depth electrodes performing an approach-avoidance decision task. It supports analysis of the differential contributions of medial and lateral orbitofrontal cortex to decision-making under conflict. The data are the authors' processed HFA, epoched per trial and aligned to trial onset and decision, and are accompanied by per-trial behavioural data and artifact-review labels.
methods_description: Patients with stereotactic depth electrodes (implanted for epilepsy, MDD or OCD) performed an approach-avoidance task. Signals were bipolar re-referenced, band-pass filtered at 0.5-200 Hz, notch filtered at 60 Hz and its harmonics, and HFA (70-150 Hz) was computed as the mean of ten 10-Hz sub-band Hilbert envelopes, each normalised to a 10 s pre-task baseline. Data were epoched per trial at 1 kHz.
